authors.bio: Norman Campbell is a television producer and director for the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation in Toronto. He has directed productions for the major networks in the U.S.A. and in Great Britain. In 1979, he was awarded the Order of Canada, and his productions have won many awards including two Emmys. He is the composer of the musical “Anne of Green Gables,” which has played in London, Tokyo, and for twenty years, in the Charlottetown Festival in Canada.
